description: This file implements a helper class for managing local notifications within a Flutter app. It handles notification initialization, channel setup, permission requests, showing notifications (including test and 'saved article' notifications), and processing notification actions such as opening a saved article or undoing a save. It interacts with platform-specific APIs for Android and iOS and maintains internal state regarding notification permissions and environment diagnostics.

classes.name: LocalNotifications.ShowResult
classes.description: Represents the result of attempting to display a notification, indicating success or failure and providing diagnostic information.

classes.name: LocalNotifications.DiagnosticsStatus
classes.description: Provides diagnostic details about notification permissions and environment status for debugging or informational purposes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes notification infrastructure, requests permissions, creates channels, and configures platform-specific settings. Must be called once during app startup.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns diagnostic information about current notification permissions, environment, and platform details.

methods.name: showTestNotification
methods.description: Displays a simple test notification to verify that local notifications are working.

methods.name: showSavedArticleNotification
methods.description: Shows a notification indicating an article has been saved, with action buttons to open the saved articles screen or undo the save.

methods.name: _toPayloadJson
methods.description: Converts a NewsArticle object into a JSON-compatible map for encoding as notification payload.

methods.name: _articleFromPayload
methods.description: Decodes a JSON payload back into a NewsArticle object, if valid.

methods.name: _handleAction
methods.description: Processes notification action responses such as opening saved articles or undoing saves, invoking navigation or updating app state accordingly.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback invoked when a notification is clicked or actioned while app is foregrounded or active.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveBackgroundNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback for background notification action response; should handle actions that can be processed without UI navigation.
